name: transcribe
description: Local, open-source meeting notes for macOS. Transcribes recordings locally with whisper-cpp, splits them into meetings, attributes speakers, and generates structured notes via an LLM.

commands.transcribe <video_file>: Transcribe and process a single recording
commands.transcribe watch <dir>: Watch a directory for new recordings (foreground)
commands.transcribe setup-daemon: Install the launchd watch agent (runs at login)
commands.transcribe autorecord: Start/stop OBS recordings when meetings begin/end
commands.transcribe voicememos: List recent macOS Voice Memos recordings
commands.transcribe voicememos --import: Import Voice Memos through the notes pipeline
commands.transcribe menubar: Menu bar app with manual record override
commands.transcribe mic: Show audio inputs, cameras, and whether a meeting is detected
commands.transcribe doctor: Check tools, models, keys, and permissions
commands.transcribe calendar-check: Grant and verify macOS Calendar access

flags.--no-split: Treat the recording as one meeting (skip meeting detection)
flags.--flat: Legacy mode: one transcript + one summary, no meeting folders

pipeline_stages: 1. Transcription: ffmpeg extracts 16 kHz mono WAV; whisper-cli with Silero VAD produces timestamped segments
2. Meeting detection: calendar events + silence gaps + LLM judgement split the recording into Meeting objects
3. Speaker attribution: sherpa-onnx clusters voices; LLM maps clusters to real names from conversation evidence
4. Notes generation: single schema-constrained LLM call (Anthropic tool-use / OpenAI JSON mode)
5. Filing: per-meeting folder in destination_directory (notes.md, notes.html, notes.json, transcript.txt, summary.txt, video clip)
6. Notification: optional Slack message with folder link

modules.cli.py: Argument parsing, command dispatch, doctor, calendar-check, voicememos
modules.audio.py: CoreAudio: which inputs are in use (meeting detection signal)
modules.autorecord.py: Meeting detection state machine, drives OBS via WebSocket
modules.camera.py: CoreMediaIO: which cameras are in use
modules.menubar.py: Menu bar app: manual override and live signal display
modules.media.py: ffmpeg/ffprobe: probe, extract audio, lossless video cut
modules.vocabulary.py: Assembles the whisper initial prompt from calendar event + mined glossary + seed
modules.whisper.py: Transcription with VAD, timestamped segments, model auto-download
modules.calendars.py: EventKit lookup; registry for future calendar sources
modules.notes.py: Notes generation and speaker naming via LLM
modules.llm.py: Provider dispatch (Anthropic / OpenAI), text and schema-constrained calls
modules.daemon.py: launchd plist generation for watch and autorecord agents
modules.links.py: Resolves a linkable URL for a destination folder (Google Drive / iCloud)
modules.gdrive.py: Optional Google Drive folder URL resolution
modules.voicememos.py: Read and import recordings from the macOS Voice Memos app
modules.permissions.py: Identify the responsible .app bundle for macOS permission prompts
modules.tls.py: TLS CA bundle fixup for frozen (PyInstaller) binaries

key_config_keys.destination_directory: Where per-meeting folders are written (default iCloud Movies)
key_config_keys.split_meetings: true (default) — detect multiple meetings per recording
key_config_keys.calendar_enabled: true (default) — use macOS Calendar for titles/attendees
